verdict.rationale: Claude Design documents its own export to PPTX, PDF and HTML, and an agent surface inside Claude Code via /design, plus a handoff bundle to Claude Code. However, nothing documents an agent triggering renders or exports through a programmatic interface, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. A community report also notes the SVG export strips animations. missing for 10: a documented API/CLI/MCP endpoint for render and export, screenshot/image rendering via a programmatic call, schema or reference docs for agent-driven export, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent-invoked export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can render and export designs — screenshots, images, or production formats — through a documented programmatic surface

citations.quote: Export to PPTX, PDF, or HTML, share an org-scoped link, hand off to Claude Code, or send to the apps you already use daily.
work directly in Claude Code with /design
Claude packages everything into a handoff bundle that you can pass to Claude Code with a single instruction.
